---
title: "check-tautological-equations.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, blocking check that fails when the two sides of an equality
render identically once the shared macros are expanded.
The case that motivated it is
[Morrison-Lab/mds#835](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/mds/pull/835),
which defined a bilinear form as
`\bform{\matr{A}}{\vx}{\vy} \eqdef \tp{\vx} \matr{A} \vy`.
The source reads as a definition,
but `\bform` expands to `\tp{#2} #1 #3`,
so the reader sees the same glyphs on both sides of the definitional equals.

## What it flags

The check reads the macros file that `macros-file` names
(by default `latex-macros/macros.qmd`) and expands every macro it defines,
with its arguments, on each side of an equality.
It then compares what TeX would typeset.

- These relations are compared:
  `=`, `:=`, `=:`, `\coloneqq`, `\eqqcolon`, `\equiv`, `\triangleq`,
  `\doteq`, an `=` under `\stackrel`, `\overset`, or `\underset`,
  and an argument-free macro that expands to one of these relations,
  such as `\eqdef`.
- Only a relation at the top level of the equation splits it.
  One inside braces, parentheses, or brackets (in any mix,
  so a half-open interval such as `[0, 1)` balances), `\left...\right`,
  or an environment other than an alignment belongs to a subexpression,
  so `\Pr(X = x) = p` compares `\Pr(X = x)` with `p`.
- In an alignment (`aligned`, `align`, `split`, `gathered`, and kin),
  `&` is ignored, and a row that opens with a relation
  continues the chain of the row before it.
  Each pair of neighbouring sides is compared.
- Spacing (`\,`, `\quad`, whitespace), sizing (`\left`, `\big`, and kin),
  empty groups, `\tag`, `\label`, and `\nonumber` are ignored,
  a group around one token is unwrapped (`x^{2}` is `x^2`),
  and trailing `.`, `,`, or `;` is dropped.

## What it does not flag

- text outside math;
- a code fence or code span, an HTML comment, or YAML front matter;
- math that defines a macro;
- an equation carrying, or following,
  `<!-- check-tautological-equations: allow -->`,
  the opt-out for a deliberate reflexivity example such as `\vx = \vx`.

## Scope

An equation is checked when a pull request adds one of its lines,
so existing hits are not reflagged on every unrelated edit.
An added line whose exact text was also deleted in the same diff
counts as moved rather than new.

With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning.
It never falls back to a whole-tree scan.
Set `whole-tree: true` to scan every tracked file in full on purpose.

Every run prints how many lines, equations, files, and macros it examined.

## Limitations

- A relation inside a macro's own expansion
  (a macro that expands to a whole equation) is not split.
- A side the check cannot expand (a macro with a missing argument,
  or a recursive macro) is skipped rather than compared.
- Macros defined in a page rather than in the macros file are not expanded.
- A brand new untracked file is invisible to `git diff`.
  Stage it to have a local run examine it.

## Inputs

| Input            | Type    | Default | Description |
| ---------------- | ------- | ------- | ----------- |
| `macros-file`    | string  | `'latex-macros/macros.qmd'` | Whitespace-separated paths of macros files whose definitions are expanded. With no readable file the check skips with a warning. |
| `globs`          | string  | `'*.qmd *.Rmd *.md'` | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive by default). |
| `paths-ignore`   | string  | `''`    | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns (relative paths) to skip. Supports `*`, `?` and recursive `**`. |
| `submodules`     | string  | `'true'` | Passed to `actions/checkout`, so the `latex-macros` submodule is available. |
| `submodule-paths` | string  | `''`     | Whitespace-separated submodule paths to initialize instead of `submodules`, for a repository with a private submodule beside the public one this check needs. |
| `fail`           | boolean | `true` | Fail the workflow when an equation's two sides render identically. |
| `whole-tree`     | boolean | `false` | Scan every tracked file in full instead of only the equations a PR touches. |
| `python-version` | string  | `'3.x'` | Python version to set up. |
| `runs-on` | string | empty (`CI_RUNNER` variable, else `ubuntu-latest`) | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it ([#1167](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167)). |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

## Example

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/check-tautological-equations.yml in your repo.
# Diff-scoped check: expands the shared macros (the latex-macros submodule's macros.qmd) on each side
# of an equality in math a PR touches, and fails when both sides render identically, such as
# `\bform{\matr{A}}{\vx}{\vy} \eqdef \tp{\vx} \matr{A} \vy` where `\bform` expands to the right side.
# Blocking by default. Skips with a warning when the macros file is missing.
# Mark a deliberate reflexivity example with `<!-- check-tautological-equations: allow -->`.
# Only contents:read is needed (the default), so no permissions block is required.
name: Check tautological equations

on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-tautological-equations.yml@v3
    with:
      # A manual run has no PR to diff against; make it report the whole tree.
      whole-tree: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
    #   macros-file: 'latex-macros/macros.qmd'  # where the macros are defined
    #   globs: '*.qmd *.md'                     # pathspecs to check (recursive)
    #   paths-ignore: 'chapters/outtakes/**'    # skip known-noisy paths
    #   submodule-paths: latex-macros           # only this submodule, beside a private one
    #   fail: false                             # warn instead of block (defaults to true)
    #   runs-on: private-runner                # self-hosted runner label (private repositories only)
```

See
[`examples/check-tautological-equations.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-tautological-equations.yml)
for the full caller stub.
